purpose: commitments to the witness partitions that were removed from this repository; the vectors themselves are not here, because a stored partition of G_eval_#### is the answer to the hold-out

recoverable_from.corpus: tools/seal_witnesses.py verify --corpus <dir> re-verifies a retained copy against these commitments
recoverable_from.git: the bytes were committed before this seal; `git show <rev>:<path_removed>` returns them until the history is rewritten (git filter-repo). The evaluator masks .git and this directory from a candidate for exactly that reason.
